title: Midori Amagaeru, Tsukasa Kyoka's 'Online - The Comic' Manga Ends
content: Manga Box published the 255th and final chapter of Midori Amagaeru and Tsukasa Kyoka 's Online: The Comic manga on August 14. Amagaeru shared an illustration celebrating the end of the manga. The manga launched on DeNA 's MangaBox app in 2013.
author: ANN

title: 1 Year Later, Crunchyroll Is Finally Streaming Solo Leveling’s Breakout Replacement
content: Solo Leveling confirmed an anime sequel in July this year, more than a year after the second season finale. The series’ first feature-length film will follow the story after the fan-favorite Jeju Island Arc. However, the anime has yet to confirm a release window.
author: ComicBook

title: 'Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Chinkururi and Nanashina 's Gacha wo Mawashite Nakama wo Fuyasu: Saikyou no Bishoujo Gundan wo Tsukuriagero ( Gacha Girls Corps ) light novel announced a pair of additional cast on Sunday. The anime series will premiere in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 Gets 2027 Release Date
content: Berserk of Gluttony Season 2 anime has officially announced a 2027 release date. The first season ran for 12 episodes from October to December 2023, with animation by studio ACGT. The announcement visual for Season 2 was previously shared in April.
author: Anime Corner

title: Berserk of Gluttony 2nd Season Anime Debuts in 2027
content: Point Set announced on Sunday that the second season for the television anime of Ichika Isshiki and fame 's Berserk of Gluttony ( Bōshoku no Berserk: Ore Dake Level to Iu Gainen wo Toppa Suru ) light novel series will debut in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Darkest Fantasy Returns With a Surprise U.S. Release Ahead of Season 3
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is easily one of the most popular Shonen series in recent years, and most of its success is thanks to the stunning adaptation by Studio MAPPA. While the first season was more than intersting enough, the director changed in Season 2, making the series even more famous among fans.
author: ComicBook

title: Live-Action One Piece Season 3 Reveals 4 New Cast Members
content: The One Piece Day '26 livestream event on Sunday revealed new cast members for One Piece: The Battle of Alabasta , the third live-action season based on Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga .
author: ANN

title: Two New 'One Piece' Anime Movies for 2027 and 2029
content: The second day of the " One Piece Day'26 " event at Makuhari Messe in Chiba announced on Sunday that Eiichiro Oda 's One Piece manga is receiving two new anime movies. The first film, titled One Piece Film God Valley , is scheduled to open in Japanese theaters in Summer 2027, while the second film, One Piece Film Baad…
author: MyAnimeList

title: One Piece God Valley Anime Movie Officially Announced for 2027, BAAD Film for 2029
content: ONE PIECE new anime film is officially covering the God Valley Incident, one of the biggest events in the story. Oda previously teased the new film at Jump Festa 2026, saying it was about something he was sure everyone would be interested in . This will be the 15th movie for the franchise.
author: Anime Corner

title: Murciélago TV Anime Debuts in January 2027
content: HIDIVE revealed at Anime NYC on Saturday the super teaser promotional video and January 2027 debut, and confirmed the television format for the anime adaptation of Kana Yoshimura 's Murciélago manga.
author: ANN
